package sample

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

const (
	Greeting = "hello there"

	Farewell = "goodbye now"
)

type Widget struct {
	Name string

	Size int
}

func (w Widget) Describe() string {
	label := strings.ToUpper(w.Name)

	return fmt.Sprintf("%s/%d", label, w.Size)
}

func Assemble(name string, size int) Widget {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(name)

	return Widget{Name: trimmed, Size: size}
}
